definitions.explanation: The system by which local communities (prefectures, cities, towns, and villages) govern themselves through elected officials and assemblies, as guaranteed by the Japanese Constitution.

examples.japanese: {地方自治|ちほうじち}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}→民主主義：05413_minshushugi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{基盤|きばん}→基盤：00220_kiban⟧だ。
examples.english: Local self-government is the foundation of democracy.

examples.japanese: {日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{地方自治|ちほうじち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{保障|ほしょう}→保障：03719_hoshou⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Constitution of Japan guarantees local self-government.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦{参加|さんか}→参加：02498_sanka⟧⟦による→による：28349_niyoru⟧{地方自治|ちほうじち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{求|もと}められている→求める：02316_motomeru⟧。
examples.english: There is a call for enhancing local self-government through citizen participation.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{地方|ちほう}→地方：02369_chihou⟧ (local, regional) + ⟦{自治|じち}→自治：03985_jichi⟧ (self-government, autonomy). Chapter 8 of the Japanese Constitution (Articles 92-95) is dedicated to {地方自治|ちほうじち}. Japan's local government structure consists of ⟦{都道府県|とどうふけん}→都道府県：14502_todoufuken⟧ (prefectures) and ⟦{市町村|しちょうそん}→市町村：16065_shichouson⟧ (municipalities).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{地方自治体|ちほうじちたい}→地方自治体：19063_chihoujichitai⟧: local government body, municipality
- {地方自治法|ちほうじちほう}: Local Autonomy Act
- {地方自治|ちほうじち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{本旨|ほんし}: the principle of local autonomy
- {地方自治|ちほうじち}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧: enhancement of local autonomy
